## Problem and change

Explain the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Describe skipped checks or
blockers. Separate fixture tests from device and live-service verification.

## Compatibility and rollout

Note any API, worker, configuration, or data changes and required coordination.
Write "Not applicable" for changes with no rollout impact.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and preserve unrelated work.
- [ ] Meaningful behavior changes have appropriate tests.
- [ ] Documentation reflects setup or behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, private configuration, or personal data are included.
